summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for $1.123 million of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due September 30, 2032, issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. The notes pay a contingent quarterly coupon of $23.75 per $1,000 note when the worst-performing of the Russell 2000 Index or EURO STOXX 50 Index is at or above its coupon barrier, priced September 29, 2026, for issue September 30, 2026. The notes are unsecured Jefferies obligations and autocallable quarterly beginning September 2027. This is a routine structured-note takedown, not a special situation.
